subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 upstream GitHub Action revisions across credential-bearing CI and release workflows after reviewing the upstream changes and final-head executions?
rationale: The patch changes executable third-party code at secret-bearing workflow boundaries; neither a mechanical diff review nor incomplete PR checks can determine the repository's acceptable supply-chain risk.

options.title: Review revisions and merge after final runs
options.body: Have the CI/security owners review the upstream changes for the credential-bearing actions, then merge only if the final-head workflow runs complete successfully.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Pause this Dependabot group and update the sensitive actions in smaller reviewed batches if the combined trust boundary is too broad.

recommendation.title: Review revisions and merge after final runs
recommendation.body: Have the CI/security owners review the upstream changes for the credential-bearing actions, then merge only if the final-head workflow runs complete successfully.
